title: The failed Columbia recording attempt
summary: His only early attempt to record, for Columbia on Canal Street with Albert Snaer's band, produced a single side of 'Zozo'.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Back to yourself, did you ever make any records in the old days?
No, I'll tell you, we tried to make a record one time for Columbia, right here on Canal. Were they there now?

They were on Canal between Charters and upstairs, yeah. And the same boy, Albert Snide, we had the band there. We went up to make a recording. And as a recording, they made the number by the name of Zozi. He'd taken the number after the name of his wife. This Ilius name he gave his wife Zozi. And they recorded one side, I don't know what ever become of it. Never recorded the other side of the record. I don't
